title: Reddit Story Time - Job Search
description:
Reddit story time!!!

If you're smarter than your friend who just got a job, you may relate 

#jobsearch #jobsearchadvice #jobsearchtips #jobsearchtools
transcript: I have been crying screaming throwing up because the job search is killing me then I remembered my friend who I'm way smarter than got a new job recently so I text her to see how she did it apparently she used something called teal to tailor her resume for her applications she told me to sign up and follow these steps download the Chrome extension use their job board to find jobs use their Resume Builder to tailor my resume for the jobs using AI get the score to over 50% for the job matching but I'm smarter than her so I did 78% create a customized cover letter with AI export the resume use their job application agent to fill out my application now I can customize all my applications and increase my chance of interviews now I'll be the one friends ask how I got a new job so quickly but I won't tell them about teal sh
